beats.text: Six phrases that quietly give away insecurity.
One. 'Not to brag, but...' — the brag always follows, because it needs you to notice.
Two. 'I really don't care what anyone thinks' — said loudly, and often, to people who didn't ask.
Three. 'I'm just being honest' — used as cover for something that was really just unkind.
Four. 'Must be nice' — envy, wearing the thin disguise of a compliment.
Five. 'I was only joking' — the standard retreat right after a quiet little dig lands.
Six. Apologising for simply existing — 'sorry' before every request, every opinion, every need.
We all do some of these. Noticing them in yourself, without shame, is where real confidence starts.
